children: Halozyme priced $1.3 billion of 1.50% convertible senior notes due 2033 and granted a 13-day option to upsell $200 million more.
Offering priced at $1.3B aggregate principal of 1.50% convertible notes due Oct 1, 2033, upsized from $1.05B.
Initial conversion rate 7.1509 shares per $1,000 principal (~$139.84/share), ~27.5% premium to $109.68 close.
Company granted initial purchasers a 13-day option to buy up to $200M additional notes; closing expected Sept 22, 2026.
Entered capped call transactions covering underlying shares with an initial cap price ~ $208.39/share to limit dilution.
Net proceeds ~ $1.275B (or ~$1.471B if option exercised); uses include $162.5M for capped calls and repurchases of outstanding 2027 and 2028 notes.
